customManagers.description: Base image digest in images/pins.yaml (docker datasource, depName=ubuntu). The Containerfile consumes the digest through the BASE_IMAGE build arg, so pins.yaml is the only source of truth.

Firecracker release version in images/pins.yaml (github-releases datasource, depName=firecracker-microvm/firecracker). Renovate cannot recompute the release tarball's sha256, so a Firecracker PR still needs a maintainer to refresh url and sha256 - see docs/dependency-updates.md.

packageRules.description: Automerge safe class 1: Go module minor/patch updates. pluto's direct dependencies (BurntSushi/toml, golang.org/x/sys) are low-risk and CI (gofmt, vet, test) is a required check. Majors are held by the last rule.
Automerge safe class 2: first-party GitHub Actions digest/pin updates (actions/**, github/**). A digest bump keeps the pinned tag and only moves the commit it points at.
Hold third-party GitHub Actions for a human. They execute in the Renovate run workflow with RENOVATE_TOKEN and in the release workflow, so a compromised release must never automerge.

Image pins stay manual until the image-build CI gate (#76) is trusted: the base image digest and the Firecracker version in images/pins.yaml, plus any literal Containerfile FROM. Removing this rule (and the two automerge rules above) reverts the repo to fully manual updates.
A major update never automerges. Last matching rule wins, so keep this rule last.
